finding_summary: NavBar.jsx uses getCurrentUser() at module scope (line 186) inside the component function body, not at true module top-level. Previous TDZ crash likely from calling getCurrentUser before its declaration.

notes: AGENTS.md references this as a recent fix. The current code appears correct - getCurrentUser is called inside the component, not at import time.

finding_summary: Vite sourcemap set to 'hidden' (line 51) - generates sourcemaps for error tracking but doesn't expose them publicly. Appropriate for production deployment.
evidence: vite.config.js line 51: `sourcemap: 'hidden'`
notes: Hidden sourcemaps allow error services (Sentry etc.) to map minified code back to source without exposing source to users.

finding_summary: MainFeed re-render loop fix implemented with liveRef pattern. Feed effect depends on [loadFeedPage, activeCategory, activeType, unique, feedConfig] instead of [loadFeedPage] alone.
evidence: AGENTS.md item 10 documents the fix. MainFeed.jsx imports and uses liveRef. auth.js getCurrentUser primes from localStorage on cold cache (lines 127-133).
notes: Fix addresses the root cause: loadFeedPage callback reference stability + ProtectedRoute cold-cache unmount cycle.

finding_summary: getCurrentUser() now primes cachedUser from localStorage via loadUserFromStorage() when in-memory cache is cold (auth.js lines 127-133). Prevents ProtectedRoute from seeing null user on page reload.
evidence: auth.js lines 127-133: if (!cachedUser) { const stored = loadUserFromStorage(); if (stored) { cachedUser = stored; cacheTime = now; } }
notes: Ensures first render after page reload gets a valid user, preventing MainFeed unmount.

finding_summary: Bug 2 from 7/28/26 chat: The bridge div (gap between trigger button and dropdown panel) has no mouse event handlers, causing dropdown to disappear when mouse traverses gap. finding_summary: Bug 3 from 7/28/26 chat: Touch devices only get click (not hover). Modern laptops register as touch-capable causing hover flow to not work. Fix: check matchMedia('(pointer:fine)'). Cannot verify without runtime test.
evidence: NavBar.jsx does not contain matchMedia('(pointer:fine)') check. Touch detection is in NavDropdown which is click-only. Requires runtime testing on touch-capable laptop.
notes: Needs runtime verification on a touch-capable device.
